topic: What support taught me about product management
content:
Two years answering support tickets taught me more product than any course.

Tickets are unfiltered discovery. Nobody writes a ticket to be polite.

I still read twenty a week. It is the cheapest research I do.

Our roadmap used to be a list of promises with dates.

Now every item is a bet: what we believe, how we will know, and when we stop.

Sales hated it for a month. Then they liked never having to explain a missed date.
